messages:
mira: Quick follow-up on the rollout-metadata divergence. Two PRs landed with different shapes: compact 'anchor_ref' + bitflags vs verbose canonical JSON. We need a migration story before consumers rely on either.

dev: Can you drop minimal examples so we can see the tradeoffs?

mira: Compact example: {"anchor_ref":"h:9f4c","flags":3}  Verbose example: {"source":"registry/v3","cohort":"canary-9","fallbacks":["small-v1"],"expires":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z","provenance":[{"commit":"a1b2c3","actor":"mira"}]}

sam: My vote: keep verbose as the canonical CP record for audits, but emit a compact stable reference in the hot-path.

ada: Agreed. Proposal: content-hash anchor model. CP stores immutable canonical JSON under anchor_hash. Creation returns anchor_hash + a tiny anchor_snapshot (routing hint) that fits in request metadata. Runtime attaches anchor_hash and snapshot.

dev: Important constraints: Dedicated/private runtimes can't require CP calls per request. Runtime must use a local LRU cache for anchor_hash -> canonical record. On cache miss: try CP GET /anchors/{hash} with short timeout (30-40ms); if miss or timeout, derive routing from anchor_snapshot.

mira: Migration path: additive fields only. Add optional fields to rollout envelope: "anchor_hash" (string) and "anchor_snapshot" (object encoded as base64 or compact JSON string). Older services ignore them. New services use anchor_hash and fetch canonical if needed.

sam: Validation: anchors are immutable. To change semantics create a new anchor_hash and link to prev_anchor. Retention: include lifecycle in canonical JSON: transient (30d), standard (180d), permanent (3650d). CP will GC but provide export before deletion.

ada: Operational SLO: GET /anchors/{hash} p95 <= 50ms. Runtimes must have a configurable fetch timeout (default 35ms) and snapshot size budget (<=256 bytes).

infra-bot: Reminder: schema changes require a documented migration plan, tests, and rollback playbook: /playbooks/schema-change-template.

mira: Action items: I'll draft a short migration appendix (field names, fallback semantics, snapshot budget), dev will spec runtime cache/timeout defaults, sam will own ops/export checklist, infra to spec anchor API and SLO. If no objections by EOD I'll open the migration PR. :thumbsup:
